verses.1: And Israel and all who were with him went forth into the land of Canaan. They came to Shechem, and there they offered sacrifices to the god of their father Isaac.
verses.2: And God said to Israel in the night, “Yakob, come here.” And Yakob said, “Here I am.”
verses.3: And I, the God of your father, say to you: Do not fear the rebellion in Egypt. For there will be a great nation that will raise you up there.
verses.4: I will descend with you from Egypt. I will also help you climb up. Then, God’s hand will be upon your eyes.
verses.5: And Jacob rose up from the valley of Shechem. The sons of Israel took their father Jacob, along with his household and livestock, in the carts that Pharaoh had sent to carry them away.
verses.6: They took their possessions and what they had acquired in the land of Canaan. Then they went out of Egypt, along with Jacob and all his descendants.
verses.7: His sons and the sons of his sons, together with their daughters and daughters of their sons, and all his descendants, they brought them out of Egypt.
verses.8: And these are the names of the sons of Israel who came from Egypt: Jacob and his sons, along with Reuben.
verses.9: And the sons of Reuben were Hanok, Palo, Hecron, and Karmi.
verses.10: And the sons of Shem were Yemuel, Yamin, Ohad, Yakhnai, Zachar, and Shaul, sons of the Canaanite people.
verses.11: And the sons of Levi were Gershon Khat and Merari.
verses.12: And the sons of Judah were Eber, Onan, Shela, Peraz, and Zarah. Eber and Onan died in the land of Canaan. The sons of Peraz became Hecten and Hamul.
verses.13: And the sons of Isachar were Tolah, Puvah, Yov and Shimeron.
verses.14: And the sons of Zebulun were Sered and Elon.
verses.15: These are the sons of Leah, who were born to Jacob in Padan Aram. Dinah was also his daughter. There were thirty-six sons and daughters in total.
verses.16: And the sons of Gad: Ziphion, Hagi Shuni, Etsbon Eri, Arodhi, and Areli.
verses.17: And the sons of Asher: Yimna, Shisha, Shivi, and Biria. They were brothers among themselves. And the sons of Biria were also brothers, along with Malchiel.
verses.18: These are the sons of Zilpah. She gave birth to Leah as her daughter. Leah then gave birth to twelve sons for Jacob.
verses.19: The sons of Rachel, the wife of Jacob: Joseph and Benjamin.
verses.20: And Joseph was born in the land of Egypt. His mother was Asenath, the daughter of Potiphar. Joseph became an officer and priest.
verses.21: And the sons of Benyamin: Balaam, Bekor, Ashebel, Gera, and Naaman. They were my brothers. Their heads were shaved and clean.
verses.22: These are the sons of Rachel, who were born to Jacob: forty-two in total.
verses.23: And the sons of Dan are wise.
verses.24: And the sons of Naphtali: Jachazel, Guni, Yizreel, and Shilom.
verses.25: These are the sons of Bilhah, who gave birth to Rachel. She gave birth to these sons for Jacob, one after another. There were seventeen of them in total.
verses.26: All the souls who came to Jacob from Egypt, they all came out from among the women of Jacob’s descendants. All sixty-six souls in total.
verses.27: And the sons of Joseph, who were born in Egypt, numbered two souls. All those souls who came from Egypt belonged to the house of Jacob. There were seventy of them.
verses.28: And he sent Judah before him, to Joshua, so that he might lead them into the land. And they came into the land.
verses.29: And Joseph forbade him from riding his horse. Then his father, Joseph, went up to him and saw him. He fell on his face and covered his face with his hands.
verses.30: And Israel said to Joseph, “This time it’s true. I see your face again, for you are still alive.”
verses.31: And Joseph said to his brothers and to his father’s house, “I will go and tell Pharaoh.” He said to them, “My brothers and my father’s household have come to me in the land of Canaan.”
verses.32: And the men were like sheep that were led by a shepherd. They were like cattle, and everything they owned was taken away from them.
verses.33: And it shall be like when I call you “Pharaoh,” and I say, “What have you done?”
verses.34: And you said, “O people of Mikhna! Your servants were your slaves from our youth. And even now, we and our fathers still remain slaves in this land of slavery. Just as the Egyptians were slaves to each other.”
